Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1a shows a large right pleural effusion (indicated by the fluid collection in the right hemithorax) associated with a mediastinal abscess containing air bubbles (arrow), which is highly suggestive of an aorto-oesophageal fistula. Compared to Figure 1b, the right-sided collection is significantly larger than the left-sided collection, and its presence is directly related to the mediastinal pathology rather than being an independent finding.
